title: 2b-B2: CDK assertions for renewal and the development-only broker fault switch
description:
Contract: docs/OWNER_CREDENTIAL_RENEWAL.md (sections 3 R18 R22, 13, 15, 17 B2, 19 steps 3 and 4). Gherkin first (features/computer_owner_credential_renewal.feature, tag @infra).

Files:
- infra/test/computer-owner-stack.test.ts: assert the broker's role holds no permission beyond GetSecretValue on the signing key and AssumeRole and TagSession on the two owner roles (no DynamoDB, S3 or SQS); both roles' trust (the broker's role, the exact tag keys with the Null and ForAllValues:StringEquals aws:TagKeys conditions) and maxSessionDuration 3600 are unchanged. This part can merge before B1.
- The development-only fault switch (decision R22; open question P4 of the contract: confirm with the owner before building): infra/lib/control-plane-stack.ts reads a CDK context (ownerBrokerFault: none, deny_supervisor_renewal or deny_turn_renewal; ownerBrokerCredentialSeconds: 900 to 3600) and sets two broker environment variables in development; synthesis throws for any other environment and names the switch. conversation/src/lambdas/owner-credential-broker.ts reads them through a faults dependency (default none): a denied purpose answers assume_role_failed, a shorter duration replaces 3600 (never longer, never below 900). The broker edit is made after B1 merges (same file).
- The CloudWatch metric filters and alarms of section 13 (owner_overdue; five consecutive owner_credentials_refresh_failed; owner_stopping reason=credentials_expired): optional in the same PR.
- infra/deploy-*.sh: document in the script header how to deploy the development ControlPlane with the context and how to restore it (the proof of section 19 steps 3 and 4 uses it).

Scenarios owned: 'Renewal adds no permission to the broker and no role changes its trust or session limit', 'The broker's development fault switch exists in development only'.

Acceptance: cd infra && npm test; npx cdk synth of the development ControlPlane with and without the context; synth for staging with the context fails and names the switch; cd conversation && npm run test:features for the broker's fault dependency.

Dependencies: P0 (assertions); B1 (the switch). Blocks the failure proof in E.

Rules: no emojis, no line comments. AWS resources exist only as CDK; never create IAM users or access keys. Do not read or write project/.
right_now_summary: The work covers CDK checks and a development-only broker fault switch, with the broker edit following B1.
